defect_reproduction.method: old DailyBarsStore.extract_rows (dev) vs fixed, one collector shaped row 2330 2026-11-20 close 2010, volume_shares 88179393, turnover_twd 177284650683

unit_check.rule: traded_value / (close * volume) must lie in [1/3, 3]; volume and value both zero is accepted; negative or one-sided zero refused
unit_check.official_row: 2330 2026-11-20 volume 88179393 value 177284650683 ratio 1.0 at close 2010 (shares and TWD)

tick_measurement.kind: synthetic hosted shape on this worker (not the hosted host)
tick_measurement.day_limits: target 4,000,000 B, alarm 6,000,000 B (unchanged; 741,723 B on incompressible synthetic floats)

bounds.memory_model: one trade date of copies in memory plus one parquet day; run files are streamed line by line
bounds.hosted_scale_estimate: 484 days at 3 days a call is 162 calls; at the measured 2.6 s a day about 21 minutes of completion work spread over ticks, plus one read of the 14 GB of run files for the index (bounded by 20 s and 40 partitions a call, resumable)
bounds.not_measured: the real 14 GB read speed on the hosted host

memory_policy.rule: stop 'memory_growth' when RSS minus RSS at call start >= max_growth_mb (768); stop 'memory_ceiling' when RSS >= 5120 MB absolute
memory_policy.against_limit: source-ingest container limit 6 GiB = 6144 MB; ceiling 5120 leaves 1 GiB headroom; hosted process RSS 2727 MB (VmHWM 2727) + 768 growth = 3495 MB, inside the ceiling; measured synthetic tick growth was about 240 MB, so growth bound has >3x margin
memory_policy.why: the previous flat 768 MB whole-process cap stopped every hosted call before the first partition (process RSS 2727 MB)
memory_policy.proof: test_a_process_already_above_768_mb_still_completes_and_growth_is_what_is_bounded injects rss 2800 MB and completes a day
memory_policy.visible_failure: a call that stops for memory with no day completed and no partition indexed sets failed=true; stored in the state file last_run and exposed as daily_bars.volume.completion_failed / last_run; the acceptance probe fails on completion_failed

storage.new_file: daily_bars_completion_state.json under the market data root, tens of bytes per stored day plus run file paths
storage.daily_bars_growth: no new rows or days; one extra generation per completed day replaces the previous one
storage.manifest: docs/operations/storage-manifest.json runtime_budgets entry added; scripts/check_storage_manifest.py passed

semantics.fill_only: a non-null stored value is never overwritten
semantics.conflicts: a source whose open/high/low/close or non-null value differs from the stored one is refused and counted (conflicts)
semantics.conflicting_duplicate: copies of one key that disagree on prices are refused in extract_rows and counted
semantics.unretained: a day with no retained source row is listed (unretained_days), not guessed
semantics.eligibility: a stored day is processed once every run-file partition with write date >= the trade date is indexed (a run file cannot hold a later trade date than its write date)

acceptance_probe: acceptance/probes/daily-bars-volume reads daily_bars.volume of GET /api/source-ingest/health (from the completion state, no parquet read); fails above zero for days newer than the fix date; the stage does not pass ACCEPTANCE_SOURCE_INGEST_URL yet so it skips (77) until it does
tests: services/source_ingestion/tests/test_daily_bars_store.py (two fixtures made coherent with the unit check)
residual_findings: The acceptance stage needs ACCEPTANCE_SOURCE_INGEST_URL (and a token if required) to run the probe.
Existing store tests used traded values unrelated to close x volume; the unit check now rejects such rows.
Hosted 14 GB read speed and the real tick time are not measured; the bounds make them safe, not fast.
A controller-tick or route trigger needs routers/observability.py in the artifact contract (Human/Ops only).
trigger: MarketDataStorageWriter starts DailyBarsCompleter.run on a daemon thread after a daily bars dual write (single flight, at most once per 30 s, SOURCE_INGEST_DAILY_BARS_COMPLETION=off disables); no new route and no controller change because routers/observability.py and main.py are outside the task artifact contract (residual: a controller-tick trigger would need the contract widened)

trigger_and_rate.external_trigger: only a daily bars dual write (MarketDataStorageWriter after a tw_price_daily run). Hosted collector price-history definitions (TWSE, TPEx) have cadence 86400 s, so about one dual write a day per source (measured nothing new on hosted: from COLLECTOR-HOSTED-ADMISSION-20261112 evidence, definition cadence)
trigger_and_rate.problem: one call per trigger at 3 days a call would take 162 triggers, about 162 days, for 484 days
trigger_and_rate.fix: the daemon thread started by a dual write now keeps making bounded calls (5 s apart, at most 400) while a call stopped only on days/seconds/partitions and made progress; a memory stop or a no-progress call ends it and the next dual write re-arms it
trigger_and_rate.hours_for_484_days: 162 calls x (about 2.6 s a day x 3 days + 5 s pause) is about 36 minutes of completion work plus the one pass over 14 GB for the index (40 partitions or 20 s a call, same loop); under 2 hours on the measured synthetic rates; real hosted read speed not measured
